title: CaseBoxMatter
description: Matter root. v1 local-first; opt-in external flags default false. See docs/adr/case-box-step-0-boundary.md.

tenant_id.description: Retained for forward compatibility; v1 = single tenant.

actor_user_id.description: v1 sentinel: "local-user" for local-only mode. See isLocalOnlyActor().

locked.description: True once any deadline exists; persistence layer enforces.

external_ocr_authorized.description: Opt-in: per-matter authorization to send documents to external OCR worker. Default false (local OCR only).

sync_grant_present.description: Opt-in: at least one sync grant exists for this matter. Default false (no companion bridge exposure).

llm_extraction_opt_in.description: Opt-in: per-case LLM candidate-fact extraction. Default false (deterministic stub only).

archived_at.description: Set when status transitions to archived. Reversible per case-box-step-0.

successor_matter_id.description: Optional reference to a successor matter (R-5(h)). Used for counsel→litigation evolution per the matter-type-immutability rule. Persistence enforces same-tenant and successor's matter_type differs from original.

case_type_text.description: Free-text case-type descriptor. Lawyer-facing only when matter_type = 'litigation'. POST-V1: controlled vocabulary. R-5(j).

case_progress_text.description: Free-text current-progress descriptor. Lawyer-facing only when matter_type = 'litigation'. POST-V1: lifecycle state machine. R-5(j).

court_contact_text.description: Free-text court contact info. Lawyer-facing only when matter_type = 'litigation'. POST-V1: structured contact entity. R-5(j).

contention_summary_text.description: Free-text summary of parties' main points of contention. Lawyer-facing only when matter_type = 'litigation'. POST-V1: structured sub-entity. R-5(j).

ulid.description: Lowercase 26-char ULID. Mirrors ocr-worker-contract's ULID convention.
